title: Past simple, past continuous, used to
subtitle: Finished actions, actions in progress, and distant past habits

rows.person: I / you / he / she / it / we / they
rows.question: **Did** I/you/he/she/it/we/they **play** …?

rows.example: I **watched** the new space documentary last night.
We **visited** the science museum four times last month.
Fifty years ago, people **didn't spend** as much time on screens as they do today.
Noah **opened** the window and **looked** down at the street.

blocks.intro: The past simple often appears with these time words and phrases:
items: {pill:an hour ago} / {pill:a week ago} / {pill:a year ago}

blocks.text: Some verbs have irregular past simple forms.
blocks.note: See the irregular verb list in your notes.

rows.use: Actions happening at a moment in the past
rows.example: At nine o'clock last night, I **was watching** a quiz show.

rows.use: Two actions in progress at the same time
rows.example: I **was reading** a magazine while you **were cooking** dinner.
It **was raining**, so Maya decided to stay at home.

blocks.intro: The past continuous often appears with these words and phrases:

blocks.text: When one action in the past happens in the middle of another, we use the past simple and the past continuous together.

blocks.correct: The phone **rang** while I **was watching** a DVD.
blocks.incorrect: Last year, I **was going** to the cinema every weekend.

blocks.text: We do not use the past continuous for regular or repeated actions in the past. Use the past simple (or **used to**) instead.

rows.person: I / you / he / she / it / we / they
rows.question: **Did** I/you/he/she/it/we/they **use to** …?

rows.example: When I was four, I **used to eat** ice cream every day.

exercises.title: A · Complete the sentences
exercises.instruction: Complete using the correct past simple form of a verb from the box. You may need a negative form.

items.prompt: I got to the post office just before it closed and ___ the parcel. (send)

exercises.title: B · Write a sentence
exercises.instruction: Use the prompts to write a full sentence in the past simple.

items.prompt: I / see / that film / last week
acceptedAnswers: I saw that film last week.
I saw that film last week

items.prompt: I / play / football / yesterday
I / go / to Paris / two years ago
acceptedAnswers: I went to Paris two years ago.
I went to Paris two years ago

items.prompt: I / finish / my homework / last night
acceptedAnswers: I finished my homework last night.
I finished my homework last night

items.prompt: I / get / a games console / in June
acceptedAnswers: I got a games console in June.
I got a games console in June

items.prompt: I / break / Mum's favourite vase / a week ago
acceptedAnswers: I broke Mum's favourite vase a week ago.
I broke Mum's favourite vase a week ago
I broke Mom's favourite vase a week ago.
I broke Mom's favourite vase a week ago

exercises.title: F · used to
